calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for SMG Swiss Marketplace Group
calls.summary: James Shannon (GrowthBook EMEA lead) demonstrated the self-hosted open-source and enterprise versions to SMG Swiss Marketplace Group, whose key participants included Lan Ha (experimentation program lead), engineers Damir, Nikola, and Guido (principal engineer), and Guilherme (eng manager). The discussion focused on pain points: current SaaS provider's per-seat pricing limits access for their 120+ engineers, and they need flexible, warehouse-native experimentation with self-hosted open-source options. Next steps: Lan will collect team questions and determine whether to proceed via email

calls.title: GrowthBook Demo for SMG Swiss Marketplace Group
calls.summary: The team is exploring GrowthBook as a self-hosted solution to unify experimentation tools across various verticals that have differing requirements. Current usage of a SaaS provider has led to limitations, both technically and in terms of pricing, as the per-seat model restricts access for over 100 engineers. The team is particularly focused on supporting server-side feature experimentation and seeking flexible pricing models that align with usage. During the evaluation, they aim to assess technical feasibility and compatibility with existing tech stacks, which include various frameworks and data warehouses. The distinction between the open source and enterprise versions of GrowthBook was also discussed, highlighting that the enterprise edition offers advanced features, governance, and dedicated support critical for larger organizations. Next steps include ongoing technical discussions and stakeholder alignment.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, experimentation, self-hosted, feature flags, pricing models, data warehouse
